perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accurized Rounds

  •  Increases range

  •  Increases magazine size

  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag

  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

notes: SpaceMonkey (PvE): "This is fine for both PvE and PvP but there are much better choices for PvP and the use case for PvE is highly specific to the point where I don't think I'd even actually recommend farming for this." Recommended MW: Reload, Handling.

SpaceMonkey (PvP): "This is fine for both PvE and PvP but there are much better choices for PvP and the use case for PvE is highly specific to the point where I don't think I'd even actually recommend farming for this." Recommended MW: Range, Stability, Handling.
